Operations Analyst Assessment — Section C
Preamble — read before answering. Questions 1–7 refer to the figures and the table in this section. Read each figure carefully: not every value is printed on it, and the text does not repeat what the figures show. Lakeview Retail runs one distribution centre (Riverside DC) and sells both online and through its stores.

Figure 1 — Monthly orders, North region. Type: vertical bar chart. Y-axis: Orders (thousands), 0–80, gridlines every 10. X-axis: Month (2024). Labelled bars: Jan 40, Feb [unreadable], Mar [unreadable], Apr [unreadable], May [unreadable], Jun 70. Caption: Figure 1. Orders per month, North region, January–June 2024.

Figure 2 — Sales by channel. Type: line chart. Y-axis: Sales ($ millions), 0–60. X-axis: Quarter, Q1'23 to Q4'24. Legend: Online (solid red line), In-store (dashed teal line). Labelled points: Online Q1'23 20, Online Q4'24 52; In-store Q1'23 45, In-store Q4'24 32. Other points [unreadable]. Caption: Figure 2. Quarterly sales by channel, 2023–2024.

Figure 3 — Refund approval process. Flowchart. Start: Refund request. Decision 1: Refund amount over $500? No → Decision 2: Days since purchase 30 or fewer? (Yes → Auto-approve; No → Store credit only). Yes → Decision 3: Customer tier Gold or Platinum? (No → Reject; Yes → Decision 4: Days since purchase 14 or fewer? (Yes → Auto-approve; No → Manager review)). Caption: Figure 3. How a refund request is decided.

Figure 4 — Riverside DC floor plan. Ground Floor Plan. Zone A: Bulk pallets, loads via Dock 2. Zone B: Cold store, loads via Dock 4. Zone C: Fragile goods, loads via Dock 7. Zone D: Returns, loads via Dock 9. Note: Each zone is loaded only through the dock directly below it. Office and charging bays not shown. Caption: Figure 4. Ground floor of Riverside DC.

Table 2 — Service levels, 2024
| Service | Target response (h) | Achieved response (h) | Target uptime (%) | Achieved uptime (%) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Billing | 4.0 | 3.8 | 99.90 | 99.91 |
| Shipping | 6.0 | 6.2 | 99.50 | 99.05 |
| Returns | 8.0 | 8.0 | 99.00 | 99.10 |
| Warehouse | 4.0 | 4.1 | 99.95 | 99.59 |
| Support | 2.0 | 1.9 | 99.90 | 99.19 |
| Payments | 1.0 | 1.2 | 99.99 | 99.95 |
